title: Japanese Ploughman's Lunch
description: A unique fusion of British ploughman's lunch and Japanese flavors.
instructions: Slice the miso bread into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
Top each bread round with a slice of cheddar cheese and place in the oven for 5 minutes, or until cheese is melted.
Meanwhile, cook the soft-boiled egg by boiling for 6-7 minutes, then immediately transferring to an ice bath.
Slice the nori seaweed sheet into strips.

Assemble the ploughman's lunch by placing a slice of the miso bread on a plate, followed by a slice of the warm egg, a few strips of nori seaweed, a dollop of wasabi mayonnaise, and a few slices of cucumber.
Garnish with pickled ginger and serve immediately.
